name: Azacitidine + Venetoclax (lower-intensity)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Tumor-lysis prophylaxis: hydration and allopurinol (or rasburicase if high risk); monitor potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid. Ramp venetoclax over the first cycle; reduce venetoclax dose with concomitant azole antifungals (strong CYP3A inhibitors).
Full neutropenic supportive care: infection prophylaxis, transfusion support for anemia/thrombocytopenia.
monitoring: CBC with differential and marrow response after count recovery.
Marrow at end of cycle 1 to guide venetoclax duration.

drugs.name: Azacitidine
drugs.notes: 75 mg/m2 SC or IV on days 1-7 of each 28-day cycle (hypomethylating backbone). Decitabine 20 mg/m2 IV days 1-5 is an alternative. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.

drugs.name: Venetoclax
drugs.notes: Target 400 mg PO once daily; ramp up during cycle 1 (100 mg day 1, 200 mg day 2, 400 mg day 3 onward) with TLS prophylaxis. Reduce dose substantially with azole antifungals (strong CYP3A inhibitors). Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
